name: Make Weight
hint: 1 + 2 + a crate = 4. Blocks count by their number.
why4: The 2-block on the 4-high tower needs two pushers up there, and getting two climbers up takes two friends underneath; without it the plate only reaches 4 if two players stay on it.
solution: P4 hops the 1-block and the crate and stands against the tower at x=17; P3 jumps onto P4's head.
P2 climbs P3 and P4 onto the tower top (height 4), hops onto the 2-block and goes right of it (x=23); P1 does the same (x=22).
P3 jumps down, picks up the crate at x=11 and carries it back left past the 1-block; P4 walks back left of the 1-block (x=7). Nobody stays under the tower edge.
P1 and P2 push the 2-block Left: it falls off the tower onto the plate (x=15-16).
P4 pushes the 1-block right until it stops against the 2-block (x=14) and hops onto it; P3 drops the crate on the left end of the plate (x=13): 2 + 1 + 1 = 4/4, gate A opens for good.
P4 and P3 walk over the blocks and through the tunnel under the tower; P2 and P1 jump down off the tower's right side.
Everyone takes a running jump over the 3-wide pit at x=33-35; P4 touches the key at x=40 and opens the door at x=46; all press Down.
